notes.title: 230317 Update
notes.notes:
Increased base zoom speed by 40%.
Added mappin function.
  - Click the mappin creation icon added at the top of the mini-map to create a mappin at the current location.
  - Click the created mappin to change its color or delete it.
  - Click the map pin displayed on the mini-map to move to that location.
Added visual effects.
  - When a star dies, it leaves behind a cloud of gas.

notes.title: 221116 update (1.00312)
notes.notes:
- Modify tip messages and highlight keywords.
- Press and hold on a book page now scrolls continuously.
- Added background and effect sound volume control options.
- Now, when a star hits a black hole, it does not instantly disappear, but continues to lose mass if it is nearby.
- Slightly increased the black hole's gravitational range, and increased its pulling power.

notes.title: 221112 update (1.0023)
notes.notes:
Page 75 Material projectile speed reduced.
A sixth tip has been added (condition: reveal all knowledge).
Other bug fixes.

notes.title: 221109 new material update
notes.notes:
To make it easier to increase the mass of a star, I've added some sort of auto-generated material to the last page.

(It is recommended to place this new material between the star and the -star.)
